entries.145e88b55f08b5e5: Based on the medium-term management plan covering the fiscal years from March 2026 to March 2028, the company states that it will promote services using natural language processing technologies such as computer-assisted translation tools (CAT), machine translation (MT) and large language models (LLM), and sales and marketing based on data analysis.
